decisive_items: Evidence of ventricular interdependence and septal bounce
Increased inferior vena cava size: 28 mm with reduced inspiratory collapse (<50%)
response.rationale: Thickened pericardium with ventricular interdependence and septal bounce are pathognomonic for constrictive pericarditis; hemodynamic discordance during exercise further supports it. Restrictive cardiomyopathy lacks pericardial thickening, and tamponade typically shows effusion rather than thickened pericardium.

rejected.why: Thickened pericardium contradicts tamponade; no effusion or pulsus paradoxus described.
No pericardial thickening; preserved EF and septal bounce favor constriction over restriction.
